explication: FRRouting (FRR) is a suite of routing daemons plus shared runtime and management components. Its principal workflow is to run routing protocols that manage IPv4/IPv6 routing; operators configure daemons through their configuration interfaces, with centralized YANG configuration available through mgmtd for migrated daemons. The README documents the protocol suite and centralized-configuration relationship, but the sampled source does not establish most daemon-to-daemon or daemon-to-kernel calls. Those links are therefore omitted rather than inferred.
